narrative_purpose: Relocate the danger correctly: burning hydrogen climbs away from the people below, so the lethal event is the loss of lift rather than the flame itself.
subject: The upper surface of a large translucent bell with a burning arrow just striking it, and a plume of pale, nearly transparent flame rising rapidly straight upward from the puncture, streaming away above the animal. The flame is thin, faint and colourless-blue rather than a thick orange fireball, and there is no smoke. Well below the fire, hanging clear of it in undisturbed air, are the woven gondolas with tiny blue-skinned figures visible on them, entirely untouched by the flame. In the far distance, small banshee riders bank away.
scene: Open sky at dusk, the burning bell filling the upper frame, the intact gondolas hanging in clear cool air beneath it.
camera: Side view from a slight distance, framed so the vertical separation between the fire above and the people below is the dominant compositional fact.
light: The hydrogen flame is faint, pale blue-white and low-luminosity, casting very little light downward; the gondolas remain in cool twilight shadow, deliberately not lit orange by the fire above.
palette: Deep indigo dusk, pale translucent bell, faint blue-white flame with only a hint of amber at its base, cool unlit gondolas below.
style: Painterly speculative-biology naturalist plate, tense but restrained, not a disaster poster.
detail_level: Crisp on the puncture point, the rising flame column and the gondolas; distant riders small and soft.
composition: Puncture and flame in the upper third rising off the top of the frame, clear dark air across the middle, gondolas in the lower third, plain dark space at one side for later callout labels.
consistency_notes: Critical: the flame must be FAINT, PALE and rising UPWARD AND AWAY, with the gondolas below clearly unlit and intact. A big orange sooty fireball engulfing everything would teach the opposite of what the chapter says. Bell matches fig-00-cover.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no labels, no orange fireball, no black smoke, no explosion, no burning people, no 3D-render or photographic look, no cartoon style
